overview: We move your shop to PrestaShop from another platform, or upgrade an old PrestaShop to the current release. First we map your products, combinations, categories, customers and orders. After you approve, we run the full move and set up redirects from your old links so that visitors and search engines land on the right pages.

faq: Which platforms can you move from?
WooCommerce, Magento, Shopify, OpenCart and older PrestaShop versions are common. We also work from CSV exports. Tell us your platform and we confirm the route before you order.
Passwords usually cannot be copied across platforms, so shoppers reset them on first login. We prepare a short note you can send before launch.
What about an old PrestaShop 1.6 shop?
Upgrading old versions means moving to a fresh install and carrying data over, because modules and themes often need replacing. The Premium package covers this for a mid sized shop.
We redirect old addresses and keep titles and descriptions, which helps. No migration can promise unchanged rankings, but we plan it to protect them.
